_fixture_notice: SYNTHETIC test fixture. This is NOT a real Instagram Download Your Information (DYI) export and contains no real personal data. It is a hand-authored, schema-representative sample modeled on Meta's publicly documented DYI JSON export shape for 'saved_posts.json' (top-level array key holding one object per saved item, each with a 'string_map_data' dict keyed by field label -> {href, timestamp}). All usernames, post URLs, collection names and timestamps below are fabricated for testing src/instagram_importer.py only. Two simplifying, documented assumptions vs. the real export: (1) the top-level array key is named 'saved_saved_media' here (Meta has used a couple of versioned key spellings across export format revisions; any of them would be handled the same way by the importer's item-extraction step) and (2) collection membership is inlined per item as a top-level 'collection' string field for fixture simplicity, rather than cross-referenced from a separate saved_collections.json the way a real export splits it — the importer is written to only need collection as a per-item field, so this does not change the shape under test.
